mascot: Dotty the Detective — a curious young detective with a big magnifying glass who hunts for clues inside every story.

slides.title: Read Like a Detective 🕵️
slides.text: Detectives look for clues. Good readers do too! Read the story slowly and look for clues: who, where, when, what!
slides.spoken: Read like a detective! Look for clues: who, where, when, what!

slides.title: Clue 1: The WHO 🧑
slides.text: Every story has people or animals in it. Ravi? Meera? A little pup? Find out WHO the story is about!
slides.spoken: Clue one: find WHO the story is about!

slides.title: Clue 2: The WHERE and WHEN 🗺️
slides.text: Did it happen in a park or at home? On Friday or in summer? Stories always leave time and place clues!
slides.spoken: Clue two: find the place and the time!

slides.title: Clue 3: The WHAT ⚡
slides.text: What happened first? What happened next? Line up the events like clues on a detective board!
slides.spoken: Clue three: what happened first and what happened next?

slides.title: Solve the Case! 🏅
slides.text: Now answer the questions with your clues! A good detective always says: 'The story told me so!'
slides.spoken: Use your clues to solve the case! The story told you so!

challenges.question: Read: 'Ravi planted a mango plant. He gave it water every day. In twelve months, it became a small tree.' What did Ravi give his plant every day?
challenges.hint: Look at the second sentence: he gave it ___ every day.
challenges.misconception: The story says 'He gave it water every day', so Ravi gave his plant water!

challenges.question: Read: 'Meera loves the rainy season. She has a blue raincoat and jumps in the puddles.' What colour is Meera's raincoat?
challenges.hint: The story names the colour of her raincoat!
challenges.misconception: The story says she wears her blue raincoat, so it is blue!

challenges.question: Read: 'The school picnic was on Friday. All the children went to the lake. They ate sandwiches under a big banyan tree.' When was the picnic?
challenges.hint: The very first words tell you the day!
challenges.misconception: The story says 'The school picnic was on Friday', so the picnic was on Friday!

challenges.question: Read: 'Arun's kite got stuck in a tall mango tree. His friend Neel brought a long stick and set the kite free.' Who helped Arun?
challenges.misconception: His friend Neel brought a long stick and set the kite free — Neel helped Arun!

challenges.question: Read: 'Grandma tells stories every evening. Her best story is about a clever rabbit and a proud lion.' What is Grandma's best story about?
challenges.hint: The second sentence names the two stars of her best story!
challenges.misconception: Grandma's best story is about a clever rabbit and a proud lion!

challenges.question: Read: 'The bus was late, so Anya walked to school with her father.' How did Anya reach school?
challenges.hint: The bus was late, so what did Anya do instead?
challenges.misconception: The bus was late, so Anya walked to school with her father!

challenges.question: From today's stories: drag each one! Is it a person or a place?
challenges.hint: Ravi and Meera are people. The lake and the banyan tree are places!
challenges.misconception: Ravi and Meera are people from the stories; the lake and the banyan tree are places!

challenges.question: A good reader, after finishing a story, should ___
challenges.hint: Detectives always review their clues after the case!
challenges.misconception: A good reader thinks about what happened in the story — that is how comprehension grows!

storyArc.theme: An English explorer masters new words, one story at a time

beats.name: setup
beats.sceneDescription: The mascot welcomes the student and introduces the topic
beats.mascotDialogue: Welcome! Let us explore English together!

beats.name: inciting
beats.sceneDescription: A playful challenge appears that needs the new skill
beats.mascotDialogue: Here comes a challenge — can you work it out?

beats.name: rising
beats.sceneDescription: The tasks grow trickier as understanding deepens
beats.mascotDialogue: You are getting stronger! Try these!

beats.name: climax
beats.sceneDescription: The hardest test of the new skill
beats.mascotDialogue: This is the big one! Show me what you learned!
